name: treemap
title: Treemap
description: Flat slice-and-dice treemap in N rows — tile area is proportional to each item's share of the total; tiles carry label, value, optional icon, badge, and link.

meta.question: How is the whole split up, and who dominates?
meta.whenToUse: Showing one full field at a glance where a few players clearly dominate — market share, install base, budget split — with roughly 5-15 items.
meta.antiUse: Not for close values (areas are hard to compare precisely) or deep hierarchies (flat only) — use rank bars or a nested treemap library instead.
